_comment: Visual-review verdicts per domain (worst→best: critical/flaw/clean, plus 'blocked' for domains with no capture to review — hard 403 / bot wall), kept separate from auto-scored *--score.json so re-running the sweep never overwrites them. The gallery merges these and can sort by verdict. Notes describe the CURRENT state only (no fix history). Update after eyeballing a re-captured clip/cast. PROVENANCE: `by` is 'ai' for a model-written verdict and 'human' for one a person confirmed; absent means UNKNOWN (bulk-entered before this field existed — treat as unverified). This file previously described itself as human-reviewed, which was not true: AI review has produced confident, specific notes that did not match the image (walmart's empty section headings and ytmusic-album's missing title were both filed as 'clean'). An existing verdict is NOT evidence a person looked.
